title: The Human Evaluation Datasheet 1.0: A Template for Recording Details of Human Evaluation Experiments in NLP
reasoning: The paper includes a section on the ethics of conducting human evaluation experiments, covering topics like research ethics committee approval and GDPR compliance. This pertains to the ethical conduct of the research study itself, rather than evaluating the moral or ethical performance of the NLP systems under investigation. The proposed datasheet does not include criteria for benchmarking a system's ethical or moral reasoning.
